title: Largest Local Values in a Matrix
summary: Given an n x n integer matrix grid, create an (n-2) x (n-2) matrix maxLocal where each element maxLocal[i][j] represents the maximum value within the 3x3 submatrix of grid centered at (i+1, j+1).
statement: Given an n x n integer matrix grid, create an (n-2) x (n-2) matrix maxLocal where each element maxLocal[i][j] represents the maximum value within the 3x3 submatrix of grid centered at (i+1, j+1). Return the resulting maxLocal matrix.
constraints: The input is an n by n matrix with n at least three.
For every contiguous three-by-three region, output its maximum.
hints: The output cell (r,c) corresponds to rows r..r+2 and columns c..c+2.
There are n-2 valid starting rows and n-2 valid starting columns.
For each start, take the maximum across its nine cells.
Enumerating exactly those starts and cells directly matches the definition of every output entry.
editorial: Enumerating exactly those starts and cells directly matches the definition of every output entry.

tests.explanation: The four overlapping three-by-three windows have maxima nine, nine, eight, and six.
The only three-by-three window has maximum two.
